items.difficulty_reason: The counted conclusion is the ascent of impurities along a flat base change at source lines 365-375, label lemma-flat-ascent-impurity, whose proof occupies source lines 377-399. The proof is a construction: it chooses an etale chart of the fibre product of the new base with the old test scheme through the prescribed pair of points, observes that the induced morphism to the old test scheme is flat at that point so that the given specialisation lifts, and then uses base change of the relative assassin to find a point of the base changed total space lying over the lifted specialisation and still in the relative assassin. The impurity then follows from comparing closures: the closure of the chosen point maps into the closure of the original point, which misses the projected point, so the image of the closure cannot contain the new base point. The counted statement records neither the chart choice nor the closure comparison.
